events.title: The April 2026 Security Update Review
events.summary: It’s time once again for Patch Tuesday, and this one is huge. We’ve also got multiple exploits in the wild, which adds another layer of urgency to this month’s release. Take a break from your regularly scheduled activities, and let’s take a look at the latest security patches from Adobe and Microsoft. If you’d rather watch the full video recap covering the entire release, you can check it out here: Adobe Patches for April 2026 For April, Adobe released 12 bulletins addressing 61 unique CVEs in Adobe Acrobat Reader, InDesign, InCopy, FrameMaker, Connect, ColdFusion, Bridge, Photoshop, Illustra…

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-32201, CVE-2026-32202, CVE-2026-33824, CVE-2026-33825 and 1 more as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-5902 is rated 9.8 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by CISA in the CVE record, the highest of the 246 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-32201 being exploited in the next 30 days at 43%, the highest of the 246 CVEs here.

events.title: CVE-2009-0238: Microsoft Office Microsoft Office Remote Code Execution
events.summary: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take complete control of an affected system if a user opens a specially crafted Excel file that includes a malformed object.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2009-0238 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-04-14, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-04-28.
CVE-2009-0238 is rated 8.8 (high) under CVSS 3.1 by CISA in the CVE record.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2009-0238 being exploited in the next 30 days at 43%.

events.title: CVE-2026-32201: Microsoft SharePoint Server Microsoft SharePoint Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
events.summary: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-32201 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-04-14, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-04-28.
CVE-2026-32201 is rated 6.5 (medium) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-32201 being exploited in the next 30 days at 43%.
